Label: End date of patient observation period

Label: LOT1 Base Discontinue Date
Definition (Validated from Protocol): The date when all induction regimen medications (and their permissible substitutions) have their last MAP_END_DT. Calculated as max(MAP_END_DT) for all MAPs where MAP_MED_TYPE is in the induction regimen or is a permissible substitution, and MAP_START_DT >= LOT1_START_DT. If ENDDATE - LOT1_BASE_DISCON_DT < 90 days, then set to missing (insufficient follow-up to confirm true discontinuation).
Additional Notes (Validated from Protoco: Protocol Section 5.1.1 (LOT end date, item 2): 'Discontinuation of all agents in the regimen: Discontinuation is defined as the run-out date of all MM treatments in the LOT.' Protocol also defines permissible substitutions that do not advance the LOT (rituximab/hyaluronidase, daratumumab/hyaluronidase, reference/biosimilar, bortezomib/ixazomib for maintenance).
Optum CDM Implementation: Source: MAP_STACKED joined to base_meds (induction + permissible subs from permissible_subs table). max(MAP_END_DT) where MAP_MED_TYPE matches base_meds and MAP_START_DT >= LOT1_START_DT. Label: Day before earliest date of a different medication occurring during induction during LOT1 BASE
